notes.title: Updata Patch Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now, monsters break the locked door, and closed door when they are chasing player.
[*] Changed the interact text when player looks at the mirror arround the altar.
[*] Changed camera rotation to be smoother while hiding in locker or closets. Additionally, players will no longer see lockers or closets when exiting them.
[*] Changed the HUD Bugs and other bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Patch Version 1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed all lighters from being placed on the stage except for the first one you get.
[*] Changed the logic the creature open the door.
[*] Fixed the error of the stage.
[*] Changed the name of chapters.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Patch Version 1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased the time it takes for the Reaper to reuse the ability after stunning the player.
[*] When the Brute enters alert mode after hearing the player walking, its animation and behavior patterns have been modified to allow the player to detect it as well.
[*] Fixed an error where items in the archive UI overlapped and did not disappear.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Patch Version 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an error where the ‘The Deal’ chapter would not open even if you returned to the main screen after clearing the ‘Basement’ chapter.
[*] Fixed an issue where mouse sensitivity, sound settings, etc. were strangely saved in the game settings.
[/list]
